title: Howdy House-Music City Nashville
description:
HOWDY HOUSE in MUSIC CITY NASHVILLE is 5 mi to Downtown, Broadway, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, CMA Fest & Iconic Venues - Ryman Auditorium, Grand Ole Opry and Country Music Hall of Fame! 3 Bedrooms, 3 Full Baths, 1 Half Bath, 2 Car Garage, and a Spacious ROOFTOP DECK with incredible views of the Nashville skyline! High-end kitchen w/granite countertops & hardwood flrs. Located near a variety of restaurants, boutique shops & bars to suit every palate. New Owner. Previous excellent reviews.

The space
3 Bedrooms, 3 Full Baths, 1 Half Bath, 2 Car Garage, and a Spacious ROOFTOP DECK with incredible views of the Nashville skyline! Sleeps 10. 4 beds and a sofa sleeper or air mattress.

Located in the heart of the city’s trendiest neighborhood, East Nashville with a vibrant, culturally diverse and eclectic spirit. Explore walking to some of Nashville’s best restaurants, cafes, record stores, and graffiti art walls. The perfect stay for eclectic adventurers. Located nearby are a variety of restaurants, boutique shops, coffee shops and bars to suit every palate. New owner just now allowing short term rentals so no reviews. Previous reviews were excellent.

Amenities:

~ 7 minute drive to downtown

~ 9 minute drive to Broadway

~ 14 minute drive to airport

~ Easy Lyft/Uber to all of Nashville’s attractions

~ Keyless entry and self check-in

~ Attached two car garage

~ 1 Gigabyte WiFi connection

~ Adjustable A/C unit in every room

~ Large dining table and custom island seating for 10

~ Filtered water and ice from fridge

~ Fully stocked kitchen with all of your cooking essentials

~ Second floor balcony

~ Three smart TVs 

~ Black out curtains in every bedroom

~ Washer/Dryer with laundry detergent for your use

~ Each bedroom complete with en suite bathroom and closet

~ Walk in shower and closet in primary suite

~ Bistro tables, chairs, and string lights to enjoy the rooftop deck & views
